title: Moves with time
text: Moves with time. We used these rugs pads for a bathroom mat and a long thin rug in the kitchen.  With time and regular use, the rug  in the kitchen on a wood floor began to slide off the mat and has to be pulled back into position on the pad.  This became more pronounced when the pad was moved to facilitate sweeping and put back.  The mat on the bathroom tile doesn't seem to work particularly at all.
